Old TV

3D model by visualdiscette.

Original work: Old TV on Sketchfab.

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

Website adaptation: the original TV GLB and its textures are preserved unchanged. The television is scaled and attached to the head socket of a cropped human torso with a neck rig. The neck and television turn toward the cursor; screen UVs and material are replaced at runtime to display animated “CLICK TO PLAY” artwork.

The creator does not endorse this website.

Human body

A-Pose - Male Full Body 3D Scan by OverseerThuror.

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

Adaptation: cropped lower body and upper head, simplified geometry, added a neck rig. Original clothing and photographic texture retained. The hidden head overlaps the TV interior to maintain a continuous join during movement. The creator does not endorse this website.
